retrieval_runtime.dense_method: FastEmbed neural text embeddings with BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5 and cosine similarity
retrieval_runtime.fallback_method: TF-IDF followed by deterministic truncated-SVD LSA and cosine similarity
retrieval_runtime.note: Annotation-specific development pooling; still not claimed as the final course production retriever.

retrieval_run_observation.provenance_limitation: The process was already in memory when provenance-writing code was upgraded. The final release therefore uses an explicitly disclosed post-hoc unchanged-cache binding; it does not claim the current builder file hash proves the earlier in-memory code image.

execution_verification.policy: Execution promotion requires raw original/fixed replay plus a separately reviewed exact-result, predicate, schema, or database-state oracle.

qrel_policy.coverage: every candidate in each saved pool; absent query-document pairs are unjudged
qrel_policy.warning: Machine-derived pooled development judgments are circular diagnostics, not independent human evaluation qrels.
